an10.115:1.1: Adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca,
an10.115:1.3: adhammañ ca viditvā dhammañ ca, anatthañ ca viditvā atthañ ca, yathā dhammo yathā attho, tathā paṭipajjitabban ti.
an10.115:1.5: idaṃ vatvā Sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi. 2.
an10.115:2.1: Atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ acirapakkantassa Bhagavato etad ahosi:
an10.115:2.2: Idaṃ kho no āvuso Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.115:2.5: adhammañ ca viditvā dhammañ ca, anatthañ ca viditvā atthañ ca, yathā dhammo yathā attho, tathā paṭipajjitabban' ti.
an10.115:2.6: Ko nu kho imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyā ti?
an10.115:3.1: Atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
an10.115:3.2: Ayaṃ kho āyasmā Ānando Satthu c' eva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ,
an10.115:3.3: pahoti cāyasmā Ānando imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
an10.115:3.4: Yan nūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṅkameyyāma, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etam atthaṃ puccheyyāma.
an10.115:3.5: Yathā no āyasmā Ānando vyākarissati, tathā naṃ dhāressāmā ti. 3.
an10.115:4.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū yenāyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Ānandena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu;
an10.115:4.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avocuṃ:
an10.115:5.1: Idaṃ kho no āvuso Ānanda Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.115:5.2: ‘adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca, anattho ca veditabbo attho ca, adhammañ ca viditvā dhammañ ca, anatthañ ca viditvā atthañ ca, yathā dhammo yathā attho,
an10.115:6.1: Tesaṃ no āvuso amhākaṃ acirapakkantassa Bhagavato etad ahosi:
an10.115:6.2: Idaṃ kho no āvuso Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.115:6.3: ‘adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca, anattho ca veditabbo attho ca, adhammañ ca viditvā dhammañ ca, anatthañ ca viditvā atthañ ca, yathā dhammo yathā attho,
an10.115:6.5: Ko nu kho imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyā ti?
an10.115:7.1: Tesaṃ no āvuso amhākaṃ etad ahosi:
an10.115:7.2: Ayaṃ kho āyasmā Ānando Satthu c' eva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ,
an10.115:7.3: pahoti cāyasmā Ānando imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
an10.115:7.4: Yan nūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṅkameyyāma, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etam atthaṃ puccheyyāma.
an10.115:7.5: Yathā no āyasmā Ānando vyākarissati, tathā naṃ dhāressāmā ti.
an10.115:8.1: Seyyathā pi āvuso puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikkamm' eva mūlaṃ atikkamma khandhaṃ sākhāpalāse sāraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ maññeyya,
an10.115:8.2: evaṃ sampadam idaṃ. Āyasmantānaṃ Satthari sammukhībhūte taṃ Bhagavantaṃ atisitvā amhe etam atthaṃ paṭipucchitabbaṃ maññetha.
an10.115:8.3: So h' āvuso Bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti passaṃ passati cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammassāmī Tathāgato.
an10.115:8.4: So c' eva pan' etassa kālo ahosi, yaṃ tumhe Bhagavantaṃ yeva upasaṅkamitvā etam atthaṃ puccheyyātha.
an10.115:8.5: Yathā vo Bhagavā vyākareyya, tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthā ti. 5.
an10.115:9.1: Addhāvuso Ānanda Bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti passaṃ passati cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammassāmī Tathāgato.
an10.115:9.2: So c' eva pan' etassa kālo ahosi, yaṃ mayaṃ Bhagavantaṃ yeva upasaṅkamitvā etam atthaṃ puccheyyāma.
an10.115:9.3: Yathā no Bhagavā vyākareyya, tathā naṃ dhāreyyāma.
an10.115:9.4: Api cāyasmā Ānando Satthu c' eva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ,
an10.115:9.5: pahoti cāyasmā Ānando imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
an10.115:10.1: Tena h' āvuso suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmī ti.
an10.115:10.2: ‘Evam āvuso' ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Ānandassa paccassosuṃ.
an10.115:11.1: Yaṃ kho no āvuso Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.115:11.4: adhammañ ca viditvā dhammañ ca, anatthañ ca viditvā atthañ ca, yathā dhammo yathā attho, tathā paṭipajjitabban' ti.
an10.115:12.1: Katamo cāvuso adhammo, katamo ca dhammo, katamo ca anattho, katamo ca attho? 7.
an10.115:13.3: ye ca micchādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho,
an10.115:13.4: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.115:15.3: ye ca micchāvimuttipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho,
an10.115:15.4: sammāvimuttipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.115:16.1: Yaṃ kho no āvuso Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.115:16.2: ‘adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca, anattho ca veditabbo attho ca, adhammañ ca viditvā dhammañ ca, anatthañ ca viditvā atthañ ca, yathā dhammo yathā attho
an10.115:16.3: tathā paṭipajjitabban' ti, imassa kho ahaṃ āvuso Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi.
an10.115:16.4: Ākaṅkhamānā ca pana tumhe āvuso Bhagavantaṃ yeva upasaṅkamitvā etam atthaṃ puccheyyātha.
an10.115:16.5: Yathā vo Bhagavā vyākaroti, tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthā ti.
an10.115:17.1: ‘Evam āvuso' ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Ānandassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:-- 8.
an10.115:18.1: Yaṃ kho no bhante Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.115:18.2: ‘adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca, anattho ca veditabbo attho ca, adhammañ ca viditvā dhamañ ca, anatthañ ca viditvā atthañ ca, yathā dhammo yathā attho,
an10.115:19.1: Tesaṃ no bhante amhākaṃ acirapakkantassa Bhagavato etad ahosi:
an10.115:19.2: Idaṃ kho no āvuso Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.115:19.3: ‘adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca, anattho ca veditabbo attho ca, adhammañ ca viditvā dhammañ ca anatthañ ca viditvā atthañ ca, yathā dhammo yathā attho,
an10.115:19.5: Ko nu kho imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyā ti?
an10.115:20.1: Tesaṃ no bhante amhākaṃ etad ahosi:
an10.115:20.2: Ayaṃ kho āyasmā Ānando Satthu c' eva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ,
an10.115:20.3: pahoti cāyasmā Ānando imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
an10.115:20.4: Yan nūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṅkameyyāma, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etam atthaṃ puccheyyāma.
an10.115:20.5: Yathā no āyasmā Ānando vyākarissati, tathā naṃ dhāressāmā ti.
an10.115:21.1: Atha kho mayaṃ bhante yenāyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṅkamimhā, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etam atthaṃ apucchimhā.
an10.115:21.2: Tesaṃ no bhante āyasmatā Ānandena imehi ākārehi imehi padehi imehi vyañjanehi attho suvibhatto ti. 9.
an10.115:22.4: maṃ ce pi tumhe bhikkhave upasaṅkamitvā etam atthaṃ puccheyyātha, aham pi c' etaṃ evam eva vyākareyyaṃ. Yathā taṃ Ānandena vyākataṃ,
an10.115:22.5: eso c' eva tassa attho, evañ ca naṃ dhāreyyāthā
